'''Jedi{{'s}} Fire''' was a phrase used in the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] to indicate a naturally occurring weather anomaly that could also manifest near [[force-field generator]]s. Essentially, Jedi's Fire was an electrostatic discharge that lit the [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] in unusual patterns. If an individual was near the discharge, a sensation of electricity could be felt "dancing" over their body.
